(379)༄༅/ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma snyan brgyud lhan cig skyes ma'i brda dbang zab mo'i sgrub thabs dbang bskur dang bcas pa zab gsang bde chen

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (379)༄༅// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma snyan brgyud lhan cig skyes ma'i brda dbang zab mo'i sgrub thabs dbang bskur dang bcas pa zab gsang bde chen shing rta zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

(380)༄༅// bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das ma lhan cig skyes ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// rjes su rab chags pad rāka lhun po la// nyi ma bye bas 'khyud pa'i gzi mdangs kyis// 'khor 'das brtan g.yo dbang du byed pa yi// bde chen dgyes rol bla ma rnal 'byor mar// gus pas btud nas snyan brgyud kyi// brda dbang zab mos dbang rnon gyi// skal ldan rjes su 'dzin pa'i tshul// khungs gtsang bklag chog yi ger spel// 'dir rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i nang zab mo brda tsam gyis dbang rnon skal pa dang ldan pa'i rgyud la rdo rje ye shes kyi dbang bzhi'i dgongs pa ngo sprod par byed pa'i gsang lam rmad du byung ba rdo rje 'chang gis rab tu phyes pa'i lam srol brgyud pa rin po che 'di nyid kyi grub thob gong ma dag gi dgongs bcud rmad du byung ba'i sgo nas gzhan rjes su 'dzin par byed pa la sbyor ba yo byad kyi gshom ni/ gnas dben par yar mar gyi tshes bcu la sogs pa'i dus bzang por gnas khang rgyan dang bkod pas mdzes par brgyan pa'i gung du rten bkram pa'i mdun stegs bu khebs ldan steng*/ ras chung snyan brgyud yum bka'i dbang bskur rgyas pa dang rjes su 'brel na de nyid kyi lugs ltar dkyil 'khor gsum bkod/ 'di nyid la sger du dgos pa'i brda dbang gi chas bris 'bur sogs gang bder bkod pas 'thus shing*/ 'di nyid khol 'don du byas skabs kyang rdul tshon ras bris gang rung rdo rwa me ris (381 )bskor ba'i chos 'byung nang du padma 'dab bzhi'i mthar dur khrod kyis bskor ba bri/ bsdu na maṇḍal tshom bus kyang 'thus/ de'i steng du mañdzi khar thod pa mtshan ldan bdud rtsi ril bu dang sbyar ba'i myos byed blugs la dar dmar gyi bkab de'i steng du me long la sindhu ra brdal bar chos 'byung bsnol ma'i dbus su padma 'dab bzhi/ lte bar hrīḥ

de'i mthar oṃ gsum ma g.yon bskor/ 'dab bzhi la ha ri ni sas bskor ba bris shing bkod/ brda dbang chas mda' gzhu/ phag mgo thod pa/ rgya gram bcas bris 'bur gang rigs phyogs gang bder bzhag /dkyil 'khor mdun nas brtsams mchod yon dang nyer spyod rnams g.yon bskor du bshams/ mdun du nang mchod ka pā lar bdud rtsi ril bu dang sbyar ba'i chang dang*/ rgyab ngos su 'bul gtor bza' bca' bzang dgu'i brgyan pa bsham/ spro na tshogs kyi yo byad kyang 'du bya/ gzhan yang sngon gtor/ las bum/ sbyar spos/ rang nyid kyi mdun du rdor dril/ ḍa ma ru/ nang mchod sogs tshogs par bya'o// nyams len dngos la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po la bdud rtsi byin rlabs/ sngon gtor/ srung 'khor/ mchod pa byin rlabs/ skyabs sems so// dang po ni/ bdag nyid skad cig gis rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gsal bar gyur/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro he sa (382) bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ dam tshig rdzas rnams mi dmigs gyur pa las// yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu yi dbyibs// ba dan gnyis kyis mtshan pa de yi steng*// raṃ las me yi dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar// zur gsum raṃ gyis mtshan pa de yi steng*// kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed po gsum la gnas// a las thod pa yangs shing rgya che'i nang*// go ku da ha na las sha lnga dang*// bi mu ma ra shu las bdud rtsi lngas// yongs su gang ba'i steng du a yig las// zla ba'i dkyil 'khor kha chod tshul du'o// de steng rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan// sngo dmar dkar ba'i hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ yig ni// mgo bo 'og tu phyogs las 'od 'phros pas// rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas rnams zhu ba yi// rlangs pas zla ba zhu zhing 'dres pa dang*// rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer hūm̐ la phog /bdud rtsir zhu dang 'dres pas kha dog sngo// āḥyig zhu bas nyi ma 'char kha bzhin// oṃ yig zhu bas zla zhun mdog tu snang*// oṃ āḥhūm̐/

rdo rjes lan gsum dkrugs pas dri ro reg /skyon rnams bsal te nus pa phun tshogs byas// lte ba'i sa bon 'od kyis ye shes kyi// bdud rtsi bkug ste ro gcig 'dres par gyur// ces nang mchod byin gyis brlabs nas mtheb srin gyis myang ste kha dag par byas/ gnyis pa sngon gtor nang mchod ltar byin rlabs byas nas/ 'bar ba'i rgyas pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ gyis mgron rnams spyan drangs la/ pad skor rdor thal kha phye bas/ oṃ kha kha khā hi sogs gsum gyis phul nas/ zhing skyong chen po sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod/ ces phrin las bcol te gtor ma phyi rol du dor/ gang dag nag po'i phyogs gyur pa/ sogs nas hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags bcas nag phyogs bskrad do// gsum pa ni/ oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ 'og thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ bar thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba dang drwa ba/ steng thams cad rdo rje'i gur dang bla bres su gyur par bsam/ bzhi pa ni/ nang mchod 'thor/ (383) zhing*/ khaṇḍa ro he sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ yig nag po'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'od du zhu ba las byung zhing lha rdzas las grub pa'i rdo rje'i mchod yon/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod pa'i sprin rab 'byams nam mkha'i dbyings dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ badzra ārghaṃ nas/ shabda 'i bar gyis byin brlab/ lnga pa ni/ bdag sogs 'gro ba nam mkha'i sogs skyabs 'gro dang*/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs sogs kyis skyabs sems lan grangs gang nus bya/ gzhan yang*/ bdag nyid skad cig gis rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyis tshogs zhing rnams spyan drangs par bsam la/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs yan lag bdun pa lan gsum bya/ mthar/ tshogs zhing rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi sgom pa sogs bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa ste sngon 'gro'i rim pa'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum/ bdag bskyed/ mdun bskyed thod pa sgrub pa dang bcas pa'i mthar dbang bskur ba'o// dang po ni/ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa nyid du gyur ces dbang bzhi pa'i don la mnyam par bzhag pa ye shes kyi tshogs gsog / stong pa'i ngang las srung ba'i 'khor lo dur khrod chen po brgyad dang bcas pa'i dbus su e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa/ rtsa ba phra zhing gdengs ka che ba/ phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su/ paṃ las sna tshogs padma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang sems yi ge hrīḥdamar po las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i ngo bor gyur/ slar 'dus te hrīḥl (384)thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog rab tu dmar zhing nyi ma 'bum gyi 'od zer 'phro ba/ spyan gsum khro zhing 'dzum pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas 'jigs byed nag po dang*/ g.yon bskums pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo mnan pa/ dbu skra nag po'i tshogs sil bur grol ba la thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang ldan pa/ thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang zhing gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug thur du brkyang bas gdug pa can la bsdig pa/ g.yon bdud bzhi'i khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ gru mo na rdo rje'i kha ṭwāṃ ga la ḍā ma ru dang*/ dril bu dar dpyang gis spras pa bsnams pa/ lang tsho phun sum tshogs shing gzi brjid dang ldan pa/ bskal pa 'jig dus kyi me ltar 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrugs pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar po las rdo rje phag mo dmar mo// snying gar ham̐ yam̐ sngon po las gshin rje ma sngon mo// khar hrīṃ mam̐ dkar mo las rmongs byed ma dkar mo// mgo bor hriṃ hriṃ ser po las skyong byed ma ser mo// spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu las skrag byed ma ljang gu/

yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud ka las tsaṇḍi ka dud kha/ shar du ha las rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sngon po sogs nas/ byang dus las las kyi mkha' 'gro ma ljang gu/ de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod khrag bsnams shing rgyan cha lugs thams cad gtso mo dang mtshungs pa'o// gtso mo'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i hrīḥ'i 'od zer gyis ye shes pa dbang lha dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ oṃ badzra ārghaṃ sogs nas/ shabda 'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan par (385)gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par gyur/ par bsam la/ oṃ shrī badzra wā ra hi ārghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ nas/ shabda 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta swa dā naṃ swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas nang mchod 'bul/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ sogs shlo ka dang*/ stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can// khams gsum pa yi ngo bo nyid// bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la 'dud// dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// sogs shlo ka dang*/ bde ba ngang rig ma skyes pa// ji bzhin nyid du rtogs gyur pas// gzhan don mthar phyin mdzad pa yi// rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun rtog 'ching ba gcod mdzad cing*// 'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug pa'i// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// bde gshegs sku la gnyis mid 'khril// zag med bde ba sku nyams bstar// sems can rnams la bde ster ma// phag mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal 'dud// lte ba'i dbus gnas 'byung bzhi 'phro// sogs shlo ka kyang bstod/ bzlas pa ni/ thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥyig sngags phreng g.yon bskor dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros/

sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul te de dag gi ye shes bdag gi rgyud la zhugs/ sdig sgrib thams cad dag /tshe bsod dpal 'byor ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur/ zhes dmigs la/ snying po oṃ gsum ma dang*/ nye snying*/ oṃ hrīḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzlas mthar/ snod bcud thams cad 'od gsal bde ba chen po'i ngang du gyur ces stong nyid du bcug / slar yang zung 'jug lhan cig skyes ma'i skur gsal bar blta'o// gnyis pa mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor dang me long la dmigs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum gyis bsang ba dang*/ zlum bskor (386) dang*/ chos 'byung rnams bya/ hrīḥha ri ni sa/ chos 'byung padma 'dab bzhi lte ba dang bcas par yi ge lnga yongs su gyur pa las/ rje btsun ma gtso 'khor lnga sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon yi ge lnga las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin rlabs sngags phreng gi rnam par spyan drangs nas me long gi sngags 'khor la thim par gyur/ ces bsam la/ oṃ gsum ma ci ltar rigs pa bzla'o// thed pa sgrub pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hrīḥha ri ni sa/ rlung me thod sgyed kyi steng du ka pā la phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ chos 'byung padma 'dab bzhi lte ba dang bcas par yi ge lngas mtshan par gyur/ par dmigs pa dang bcas oṃ gsum ma ci rigs bzlas/ mthar lag pa g.yon du/ hrīḥha ri ni sa/ chos 'byung padma 'dab bzhi lte ba dang bcas par yi ge lnga yongs su gyur pa las rje btsun ma gtso 'khor lnga sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ lag pa lha'i dkyil 'khor bdud rtsir zhu ba/ thod pa sngags kyi dkyil 'khor dang dbyer med du gyur pa las ngo bo lha dang sngags kyi rang bzhin rnam pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/

par bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum brjod/ srin lag gis blangs te rang dang phyogs mtshams mchod rdzas la 'thor zhing*/ drwa gur dang*/ ba spu'i bu ga rnams mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs dang*/ bdud rtsir gyur/ par bsam zhing oṃ gsum ma lan gsum brjod/ oṃ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma thams cad kyi zhal du= 'bru gsum brjod pas rang gis myang*/ gong ltar mchod bstod mdor bsdus bya/ gtor (387 )ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlab la/ pheṃ gsum gyis gtor mgron spyan drangs la/ na mo ratna gu ru e daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pas bla ma dang*/ oṃ gsum ma'i mthar i daṃ sogs brtags pas bcom ldan 'das ma la ste lan gsum res 'bul/ mchod bstod mdor bsdus bya'o// de nas slob ma la ji tsam bskur ba'i dbang bdag nyid kyi dmigs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis blang bar bya ba yin no// slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i tshul ni/ las bum du khaṇḍa ro he bskyed bzlas 'od zhu byas pa'i chus slob ma rnams phyi rol du khrus nas dbyung zhing*/ sngon gtor srung mtshams gong du smos pa bzhin btang nas me tog bkye bsdu grub pa dang bsam pa 'chos pa'i chos bshad ji ltar rigs pa'i mthar lo rgyus kyi des shes bskyed pa ni/ 'dir ma rgyud mtha' dag gi yang snying bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa'i yum bka'i dkyil 'khor rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rgyud sde thams cad kyi yang snying zab pa las kyang ches zab pa ste/ spyir sangs rgyas thams cad skyed mdzad kyi yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma nyid/ rdo rje snyems ma dang*/ sna tshogs yum bdag med ma/ rdo rje phag mo sogs mtshan dang sku'i rnam 'gyur mtha' yas pa las 'dir rdo rje phag mo// de la'ang rgyud gzhung so so'i rjes su 'brangs ba'i sgrub thabs du ma'i nang na khyad par du 'phags pa'i bka' babs kyi chu bo thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa ste/

dang po khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dang 'khor lo'i dbang mo dbyer med pas bram ze chen po sang ha rjes su bzung*/ de nas sha ba ra/ kor ni ru ba/ tsang ngu pa/ 'gar sngags nan nas rje sgam po pa la brgyud pa zhal gnyis ma'i phyogs dang*/ chos sku ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro mas mnga' bdag mai tri pa/ des rje btsun chos kyi blo gros brda'i dbang zab mos smin par mdzad pa ni rdo rje'i mgur las gsal bar gsungs pa ltar rim pas brgyud pa zhal gnyis ma'i nye brgyud dang*/ drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen pos dpal tai lo sangs rgyas/ des paṇa chen nā ro (388)zhabs/ des bod yul phyi dar gyi lo tsā ba thams cad kyi rgyal po rtsod med grub thob dgyes mdzad rdo rje dngos snang lho brag mar pa la gnang ba rim par mi la ras chen/ mnyam med dwags po sogs las brgyud pa ni snyan brgyud lhan cig skyes ma rang gzhung gi don brgyud dang*/ khyad par snyan brgyud lhan skyes ma'i dbang dang man ngag mtha' dag rje mar pas byang phyogs tsam na che ba'i grub thob yongs gyi spyi mes rje btsun bzhad pa rdo rjer bum pa gang byor stsal/ rje btsun gyis rgyas 'bring bsdus pa'i skor tsho gsum du phyes te thugs kyi sras mchog gsam la gtso bor gnang ba'i rtsa ba'i smin byed rgyas pa zur du mchis pa las/ 'dir de dag gi snying po'i gsang don zab mo brda'i dbang bzhi byin rlabs gyi tshul du bskur ba ni/ rje btsun ras pas/ nang zab mo brda yi dbang bzhi de// dus da lta bskur na dga' ba la// da lta bskur na skyid pa la// nga 'bul ba chung yang 'bul snying 'dod// mos gus chung yang zhu ba zhig lags te/ zhes gsungs pa ltar gsang ba'i de kho na nyid dbang rnon gyi rgyud la rtsol ba med pa brda tsam gyi thabs la brten nas ngo sprod cing rgyud smin par byed pa'i gdams pa zab mo 'di nyid kyi brgyud pa'i chu bo thams cad gcig 'des kyi lugs su/

'dir rje btsun 'ja' tshon gyi sku can skyes bu ras chung rdo rje grags pa'i bka' srol snyan brgyud 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum 'bring po las yum bka' lhan cig skyes ma dang 'brel ba'i zab mo brda'i dbang gis skal ldan gyis rgyud smin par bgyid pa skabs su bab pa la thog mar zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/

zhes mtshams sbyar maṇḍal phul nas/ de ltar maṇḍal phul bas mtshams sbyar nas dbang gi ched du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dam pa rje btsun pa rnams dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lha tshogs thams cad la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// bdag la de bzhin nyid kyi ye shes nam (389)mkha' lta bus gang bar mdzad du gsol/ smin par mdzad du gsol/ yongs su smin par mdzad du gsol/ shin tu smin par mdzad du gsol/ de bzhin nyid kyi ye shes nor bu lta bus gang bar mdzad du gsol sogs gong ltar/ de bzhin nyid kyi ye shes bdud rtsi lta bus sogs gong ltar gsol ba gdab/ ye shes pa dbab pa la/ da ye shes pa dbab pa dbang gi gzhi dgod pa la lus gnad dang ldan pas dmigs pa 'di ltar mdzod/ slob ma rnams skad cig gis sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥyig dmar po yongs su gyur pa las rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog rab tu dmar zhing nyi ma 'bum gyi 'od zer 'phro ba/ spyan gsum khro zhing 'dzum pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ dbu skra nag po'i tshogs sil bur grol ba la thod skam lngas dbu brgyan pa/ thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang zhing gcer mo phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rje'i gri gug zur du bsdig pa/ g.yon pas gdug pa'i khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ gru mo na rdo rje'i kha ṭwāṃ ga la ḍā ma ru dang*/ dril bu dar dpyang gis spras pa bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas 'jigs byed nag po dang*/ g.yon bskums pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo mnan pa/ gzhon nu ma'i lang tsho'i dpal phun sum tshogs pa/ bskal pa 'jig dus kyi me ltar 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrugs pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i smin mtshams su'ang rje btsun ma'i sku gsal la dod pa mgal me'i 'khor lo ltar 'khor ba/ snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng na bai ro tsa na'i sngags phreng g.yon bskor du dmar sga ra ra 'khor ba/

lte bar chos 'byung dmar po'i dbus na padma 'dab bzhi'i lte bar hrīḥ 'dab ma bzhi la ha ri ni sa g.yon du 'khor ba/ de ltar gsal ba'i lha dang yig 'bru rnams las 'od zer (390)'phros pas lus kyi nang gang sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dag /slar yang sindhū ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus kyi hrīḥyig las 'od zer dmar po rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lha tshogs rnams kyi rnam pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ slob ma'i snying ga dang lte ba'i hrīḥl thim pas zag pa med pa'i bde ba chen pos gang bar gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod cig / byas la 'beb rdzas bdug /thod rnga dang dril bu'i sgra sbyar bas/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ badzra wā ra hi a be shā ya āḥ.āḥ zhes bzlas pas byin dbab/ ye shes pa phab pa de nyid sngags rgyas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ spyi bor rdo rje bsnol mar bkod de/ tiṣṭha badzra/ de dag gis ni byin rlabs kyi snod rung du bsgrub pa sngon du bya ba'i rim pa lags/ dngos gzhi ni mnga' bdag mar pas rje mai tri pa mjal dus kyi rdo rje'i mgur las/ nang zab mo brda yi dbang bzhi bskur// rgyud yongs su smin par byin gyis brlabs/ zhes gsungs pa'i don khyad chos thun mong ma yin pa brda yis dbang bzhi ngo sprod pa'i tshul ni 'di dag tu gda' bas so so'i brda don shes pa'i sgo nas ma yengs par gsan 'tshal// zhes pas mda' gzhu/ phag mgo/ thod pa/ rdo rje rgya gram rnams 'og gi tshig ris dang bstun te rim par bstan la/ khyed rnams la mda' gzhu bstan pa 'di thabs shes dbyer med kyi brda ste/ lha yab yum snang stong gi bskyed rim sgoms shig pa'i brda'o// phag mgo bstan pa 'di phag pas kha zas la gtsang rme med par longs spyod pa ltar gnyis med kyi ye shes sgoms shig pa'i brda'o// thod pa bstan pa 'di'i nang stong par yod pa ltar chos thams cad stong nyid du sgoms shig pa'i brda'o// rdo rje rgya gram bstan pa 'di'i rwa rnams phyogs bzhir yod pa ltar phrin las rnam pa bzhi la dbang ba'i brda'o// de ltar na de rnams ni bum dbang gi don yin no//

de nas bdud rtsi lce thog tu byin te/ bdud rtsi'i ro (391)bde ba des lus thams cad bde phril gyis song bar sgoms shig /de ni gsang ba'i dbang gi don yin no// bde ba de'i ngo bo rnam par mi rtog par sgoms shig /de ni shes rab ye shes kyi dbang yin no// de nas slob dpon gyis lag mthil stong pa dang*/ der rdo rje bzhag pa dang*/ se gol gsum rim par bstan la/ khyed rnams la lag mthil stong par bstan pa 'di chos thams cad skye ba med pa'i brda'o// de'i steng du rdo rje bzhag pa 'di snang grags kyi chos thams cad med bzhin glo bur du snang ba'i brda'o// se gol gsum tog pa 'dis sgra thams cad grags stong du gcig pa ltar chos thams cad du ma ro gcig gi brda'o// phyag rgya chen po'i gnas mchog na// byang chub sems dpa' spyod pa'i blo gros bzhugs// de ni ming tsam brda tsam btags pa tsam/ lan gsum/ de ltar chos thams cad dngos po de nyid du ma grub/ khyed rang gi sems nyid gzhi med rtsa bral spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba'o// sna tshogs su snang yang snang sems gnyis med chos kyi sku ngos bzung med par ngo shes par gyis shig /de yang ming dang brda tsam du shes pa ni dbang bzhi pa'i don yin no// zhes ngo sprad do// brda bzhi'i don 'di dag rgyas shing spro na zhib par spros te bshad nas go brnyed par bya'o// de ltar na de dag gi sgo nas bcom ldan 'das ma rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma snyan brgyud lhan cig skyes ma la brten pa'i thun mong ma yin pa nang zab mo brda'i dbang bzhi'i byin rlabs ngo sprod kyi rim pa brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes ltar legs par grub pa'i skabs su thob cing zhal gyis bzhes pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa'i gnas la srung sdom tshul bzhin bgyi'o snyam pa'i blos 'di'i rjes zlos/ gtso bos ji ltar (392)sogs/ de ltar dbang bskur zab mo phyag rgya chen po rdo rje'i ye shes kyi byin rlabs su grags pa legs par thob pa'i sku drin gtong rag gi yon du dmigs te maṇḍal re gnang bar zhu/

zhes maṇḍal phul/ rang gi lus longs spyod dge rtsa dang bcas pa bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo gnyis su ma mchis pa la gus pas 'bul na cha shas nas bzhes la longs spyad du gsol snyams pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ deng nas brtsams te sogs/ dge ba bsngos te slob ma rnams rang gnas su btang ngo*// gsum pa rjes ni/ tshogs mchod spro na yum bka' rgyas pa'i sgrub dkyil ltar shes par byas la dkyus su mi dgos/ mchod pa byin rlabs/ mchod bstod rnams gong du smos pa ltar dang*/ bzod gsol/ rten yod na rten bzhugs dang med na gshegs gsol/ bsngo ba smon lam/ shis brjod rnams spyi ltar byas pas 'grub bo// brda dbang 'di ni rje btsun ma so sor phyes na bden gnyis zhal pa dang gtso bor 'brel yang*/ bla ma dam pa gong ma rnams kyi phyag bzhes la lugs gnyis ka'i smin byed du'ang mdzad pas stag lung rjes gnang zhe gsum ma'i khongs nas bden gnyis zhal can la sbyar ba'i brda dbang nyid skabs 'dir brgyud pa'i chu bo thams cad gcig 'dres kyi bka' srol kho nar nges pas ras chung snyan brgyud lugs kyi lhan cig skyes mar sbyar te rgyun dang khungs thub kyi yig cha dag las tshig gi phrad dang bsnon 'brid phren bu tsam ma gtogs slad dang rang bzo'i dri ma med par bklags chog tu bsdebs pa'o// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum mchog rje btsun ma// drwa ba sdom pa dgyes pa'i btsun mo ni// dus mtha'i me lce lta bu'i gzi brjid kyis// 'khor 'das za byed dpa' mo tsaṇḍa lī'i// shin tu zab pa'i mthar thug brda yi dbang*// rdo rje 'chang gi zhal lung mngar po'i bcud// grub thob rgya mtshos myang de 'dir byung na// skal ldan kun kyang bde chen gyis myos shog /ces gdams ngag rin po che'i mdzod (393) bka' brgyud kyi smin byed las snyan brgyud lhan cig skyes ma'i smin dbang gi cha lag tu 'jam mgon bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi dgongs bzhed mchis pa dang bka'i rjes su gnang ba nos pa la brten nas gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams kyi bka' 'bangs tha shal pa karma bkra shis 'od zer kyis dpal spungs sgrub khang gi skyed mos tshal lha klu dgyes par rol pa'i bsti gnas su stan thog gcig tu spel ba'i yi ge pa ni karma bkra shis chos 'phel gyis bgyis pas dpal ldan bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs shing zab gsang bstan pa mi nyams yun du gsal ba'i rgyur gyur cig
